title: Universal homeomorphisms of algebraic stacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the size convention of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use algebraic stacks as in [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack], and their morphisms and 2-fibre products as in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Point classes and their smooth-atlas topology are those of [def-sfb-stack-point-topological-space]. A morphism $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ is a universal homeomorphism if for every algebraic stack $\mathcal Z$ in the chosen universe bound and every morphism $g:\mathcal Z\to\mathcal Y$, the actual projection $\mathcal Z\times_{\mathcal Y}\mathcal X\to\mathcal Z$ induces a homeomorphism of underlying point spaces. The test bound includes the scheme site and both endpoint category universes; the tests are not restricted to Deligne--Mumford stacks or representable morphisms.
